meta.title: Ecommerce & Shopify Projects Kerala & GCC | Teknoppy Portfolio
meta.description: WooCommerce and Shopify stores built by Teknoppy for retailers in Kerala, the UAE, the UK and India, each linked to a full case study.

body.html: Online stores Teknoppy has built on WooCommerce and Shopify for retailers in Kerala, the UAE, the UK and India — covering product catalogues, payment setup, checkout design and post-launch conversion tracking. A store is judged on what happens after launch, not at it, so each build here was set up to be measured from day one.

sections.intro: The services these stores draw on, each with its own page.

items.title: Ecommerce Website Development
items.text: Full store builds — catalogue structure, product templates, checkout and post-launch tracking.

items.title: Shopify Development
items.text: Shopify store setup, theme customisation and app configuration for D2C and retail brands.

items.title: WooCommerce Development
items.text: WooCommerce stores on WordPress, for clients who want the catalogue and the content site on one platform.

items.title: Payment Gateway Integration
items.text: Domestic and international gateway setup, including multi-currency checkout for GCC and overseas customers.

items.title: Custom Ecommerce Development
items.text: Stores whose catalogue, pricing or fulfilment rules do not fit a standard platform without custom work.

items.title: Ecommerce SEO
items.text: Category and product-page search work on live stores, run after launch rather than bolted on later.

paragraphs.html: Platform choice on these projects followed the catalogue, not a preference — Shopify where the client wanted a hosted store and fast setup, WooCommerce where the store had to sit alongside a large content site. Several also run ecommerce SEO after launch.
Conversion, traffic and revenue figures for these stores are documented on Case Studies. For the wider portfolio, see all project categories.

items.q: Do you build on Shopify or WooCommerce?
items.a: Both. The projects above include three Shopify stores and three built on other ecommerce stacks — the platform is chosen to fit the catalogue and the client's team, not the other way round.

items.q: Have you built stores that sell outside India?
items.a: Yes. The stores above include a UK training platform, a Dubai nursery and a UAE fashion brand, with multi-currency checkout and international payment gateways configured accordingly.

devNotes.cardSource: The project cards are copied from the matching group(s) in src/data/pages/case-study.json so the two directories cannot drift. Add a new case study to that file first, then mirror it here.
devNotes.roleSplit: Portfolio pages stay visual and project-based; ranking, traffic and revenue figures belong on /case-study/ and its sub-pages. Do not restate results here — that is the duplicate-content risk the hub's devNotes call out.
